notes.title: Charting the Final Course: Share Your Vision for MILF Odyssey's Ending
notes.notes:
Every end is a new beginning. 
As some of you know, there will not be a Season 2 (I explained why on Discord), but I am working on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3328350/Galactic_Sex_Odyssey_NSFW_SciFi_Porn/?utm_source=steam_crosspromo&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=odyssey]Galactic Sex Odyssey[/url][/b]! This time I’ve planned an original story (no parody), but strong Trek vibes, with a few twists. 

As I get ready to plan the final chapters of MILF Odyssey, I invite you, THE FANS, to share your suggestions in shaping the game's grand finale. 

Your journeys with the characters, the triumphs, and the challenges have all led to this moment. 

Now, I ask: [b]what are your wildest fantasies for the conclusion of this epic adventure? For your favorite characters?[/b]

Here are some of the high level ideas I’ve been toying with[b] (spoilers ahead!!!)[/b].

Before I dive in, I hope you won't mind if I plug some free demos for 2 cool titles I'm publishing, I hope you'll like them and wishlist the titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479348/e28cc7ac29b8aac04509ed1ac61286f835f686fc.jpg[/img]

[h3]And now, [b]Light Spoiler Time![/b][/h3]



[h3][b]The “Canon” Ending[/b][/h3]
The current trajectory for the Federation ending unfolds with a triumphant note:
    • [b]Victory Over The Federation’s enemies.[/b]
    • [b]House Droghorn rises again.[/b]
    • [b]A satisfying ending for every female character: [/b]This is where I need your feedback in the comments! How would you like it to end for your favorite girl? (Cory/Draz’s ending is already written and rendered)
    •[b]Ride into the sunset:[/b] With honor and distinction, MC is promoted to Captain, and flies into the sunset with his sexy crew/harem.

[h3][b]Your Thoughts on the Federation Ending?[/b][/h3]
    • How would you like it to end for your favorite girl? How about the villains and girls you hate most?
    • Let me know in the comments, I will respond to every suggestion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479348/0d2e21718f176a276e19024a88213213dbfc1081.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Exploring Alternate Endings: Maledom & Femdom Endings
[/b][/h3]Beyond the “canon” Federation ending, I’m considering two alternate endings, released as a later chapter, influenced by your feedback. Maledom and Femdom. Not sure about this yet, but this would provide exciting alternate endings!


[h3][b]Character Spotlight[/b][/h3]
Whether it's Asheera, with her tantalizing "catnip" scene, or another beloved character, I will create character profiles to discuss individual endings in more details for the most popular characters, so let me know the top one or two character endings you’d like to see!

[h3][b]Share Your Vision![/b][/h3]
Your input is invaluable in crafting a conclusion that resonates with your wants and desires. Please share your thoughts, preferences, and any questions you might have in the comments below!

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Major Update: Voicing, Moans, and Bonus Wallpapers!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Odysseans!

I am thrilled to announce the release of a significant update to the Odyssey that will elevate your experience to new heights! I hope you will enjoy re-experiencing the Odyssey with its new audio features (you can adjust the volume of voices/moans/music independently).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479348/3f30652d06690887298813bffe638f95cccb2b94.jpg[/img]

[h2]Voice Acting:[/h2]

Prepare to finally hear the characters come to life!

[h2]Moans:[/h2]

Prepare to finally hear the characters CUM to life! 
In my opinion, this addition REALLY enhances the experience, and justifies playing it again...

[h2]Exclusive Bonus Wallpapers:[/h2]

Over 20 high-quality wallpapers at different resolutions, allowing you to adorn your desktop or mobile device with the charms of your favorite characters. 

[h2]How to Access the New Features:[/h2]

Simply head over to your Steam library, locate the Odyssey, and the update will automatically download. Once installed, launch the game to experience the magic of voice acting and to find the exclusive bonus wallpapers in the game's extras menu.

[h2]The Final Chapter is coming![/h2]

I'm currently brainstorming... Let me know how you'd like things to end for your favorite character!

[h2]Share Your Experience:[/h2]

I would love to hear your thoughts and reactions to the latest update! Join the community on Steam or Discord and share your experiences and any request you may have. Your feedback is invaluable and helps me continue to refine and enhance the Odyssey based on your preferences.

Have fun!
XCentric
